payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_finish.py::test_a_red_finish_names_each_new_failure_it_counts stayed green with the criterion's own edit applied to saffron/cli.py. The claim was '`finish.publish_finish`\'s `verify` returns the new failures themselves. On a red suite its first line is still the escalation line it prints at base, `escalate: red suite, N new failures`. One line follows per new failure, in the order `verify` returned them. Each is exactly `"  " + events._clean(baseline.render(failure), events._DETAIL_BOUND)`: two spaces, then the rendering with every control character replaced by a space and clipped to 500 characters. The witness drives a failure with a file and a line, one with no file, and one whose message carries an escape sequence, a newline and a tab and runs past 2000 characters.'. Under the edit the whole `tests` gate failed tests/test_cli.py::test_a_stack_batch_publishes_its_finish_through_the_finishing_suite, tests/test_saffron_gates.py::test_types_names_its_tool_and_passes_on_a_clean_tree, tests/test_saffron_gates.py::test_the_fast_gates_name_their_tool_and_pass_on_a_clean_tree[format], and the criterion's witness did not fail.
